rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a fair-quality expanded/full blastocyst with B-grade ICM and TE, notes thinned zona and no clear hatching; minor uncertainty between 3BB and 4BB prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, male factor, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors; slight overreach in discussing fresh-cycle hormonal effects without supporting lab values.
Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and optional PGT-A; minor speculative elements keep it from full marks.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer management and future planning, including cohort review, luteal support, and escalation only if repeated failure occurs.
